we have developed a methodology for the analysis of a C SES, and applied that methodology to the water service delivery situation in a small South Africa municipality, Makana, in order to provide the context for the study of the emergence and practice of a civil society organization (Water for Dighity) seeking to improve water services in Makana.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is not enough to identify the elements and relationships within a CSES.

a systemic understanding of a complex social ecological water service delivery system is a useful basis from which to understand and support the emergence, practice, and learning process of civil society organisations seeking to confront water security issues in a small South Africa municipality.

a C SES perspective can help to understand the complex nature of water service delivery challenges in South Africa and to identify the key elements and relationships that need to be addressed in order to move towards improved service delivery.
